question_text: After retiring as a city planning officer, Mr. Cruz wants to open a private consultancy firm that will offer services to developers seeking building permits from his former office. Under RA 6713, which of the following is correct?

options.text: Mr. Cruz may immediately engage in such consultancy because he is no longer a government employee.
Mr. Cruz may engage in consultancy but only after one year from retirement.
Mr. Cruz may engage in consultancy but only for projects outside his former office's jurisdiction.
Mr. Cruz may not engage in any consultancy related to his former office for a period of one year.
